premises.text: Gen Y spenders do not know where their money goes and need better budgeting/tracking
premises.evidence_span: I have no idea where my money goes

premises.text: Expense inputs on phone must complete in under three seconds with pattern-aware tags
premises.evidence_span: input any expense in under three seconds

premises.text: The app never asks for credit card, bank information, or even name
premises.evidence_span: We'll never ask you for your credit card or bank information, not even your name

premises.text: Game mechanics—experience points, tokens, achievements, and leveling—encourage tracking habits
premises.evidence_span: we add those same principles to encourage them to track their cash

premises.text: Users can create subcategory budgets that track tagged spending against a goal
premises.evidence_span: we've gone one step farther and allowed for subcategorization

premises.text: Demographic You Versus Them insights compare a user's spending to their age group
premises.evidence_span: with the You Versus Them feature, I can show you insights like never before

premises.text: Tokens unlock merchant deals; monetization places the right deals with the right audience
Spends remains free for users forever
premises.evidence_span: For users, Spends will always be free

value.text: Fun, fast budgeting and spending tracking so users know where money goes
value.evidence_span: solve the problem of budgeting and tracking your money. Not like everybody else, but fun and fast

causal_links.evidence_span: I have no idea where my money goes
For users, Spends will always be free

notes: XP/tokens/achievements/levels folded as one gamification mechanism (§4.1.7). Web dashboard treated as surface of same tracking product, not a separate premise. Bootstrap/launch timing excluded as traction (§4.2). Three domains—anti-template: problem, product capabilities, and deals/free model are separately revisable.
